verifications.claim: The Sun is ~4.6 billion years old.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Age 4.6 billion years [R1]; About 4.5 billion years ago [R2]; It is about 4.5 billion years old [R5]; around 4.6 billion years ago [R6]
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the Sun's age as approximately 4.6 or 4.5 billion years.

verifications.claim: The Sun is a G-type main-sequence star.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Spectral classification G2V; It is now classified as a G-type main-sequence star (G2V) [R1]

verifications.claim: The Sun is at the center of our solar system.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The Sun is the star at the centre of the Solar System [R1]; the center of our solar system [implied in R2, R3, R5]
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated in R1 and implied consistently across sources.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 5,772 K (photosphere) [~5,500°C, ~10,400°F, approximate match] [R1]; Surface temperature 5500 °C [R2, R6]
verifications.reasoning: R1 gives precise 5,772 K (~5,500°C), R2/R6 exactly 5500°C; Fahrenheit approximate.

verifications.claim: In ~5 billion years, the Sun will exhaust its hydrogen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: About 4 to 7 billion years from now, when hydrogen fusion in the Sun's core diminishes [R1]; in about 5 billion years, the sun will run out of hydrogen [R4]
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for hydrogen exhaustion in ~5 billion years.

verifications.claim: The Sun will expand into a red giant.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: transforming the Sun into a red giant [R1]; the sun will enter the red giant phase [R4]; become a big, cool star called a red giant [R5]

verifications.claim: The Sun is roughly halfway through its 10-billion-year lifespan.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The Sun today is roughly halfway through the main-sequence portion of its life; approximately 10 to 11 billion years as a main-sequence star [R1]
verifications.reasoning: Directly matches age and total main-sequence lifespan.

verifications.claim: The Sun contains 99.8% of the solar system's mass.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: making up about 99.86% of the total mass [R1]; contains about 99.8 percent [R2]; accounts for 99.8 percent [R3, R5]
verifications.reasoning: Precise match or very close approximation.

verifications.claim: The Sun is a sphere of plasma.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: massive sphere of hot plasma [R1]; blazing combination of gases... in the form of plasma [R2]

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: outflowing solar wind [R1]; stream of extremely hot, charged particles that are thrown out from the upper atmosphere of the sun [R2]
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly described as originating from the Sun.

verifications.claim: Ra is the Egyptian sun god.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: the Sun was worshipped as the god Ra [R1]

verifications.claim: Helios is the Greek sun god.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: To the Greeks, he was Helios [R1]

verifications.claim: Huitzilopochtli is the Aztec sun god.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: Sources mention Tonatiuh as Aztec sun god, but not Huitzilopochtli.

verifications.claim: The distance from the Sun to Earth is ~93 million miles (150 million km).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: about 1.496×108 kilometres [R1]; 150 million kilometers (93 million miles) [R2]
verifications.reasoning: Exact match for average distance (1 AU).

verifications.claim: The Sun's lifespan is ~10 billion years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: approximately 10 to 11 billion years as a main-sequence star [R1]
verifications.reasoning: Refers to main-sequence lifespan, which is the primary stable phase; total lifespan longer but claim approximates this.

verifications.claim: The Sun's composition is primarily hydrogen fusing into helium.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: consists mainly of the elements hydrogen and helium... fuses about 600 billion kilograms of hydrogen into helium [R1]; three quarters of the sun is hydrogen, which is constantly fusing together and creating helium [R2]
verifications.reasoning: Directly describes composition and fusion process.
